name: Property Management
author: DIGISTALTER GmbH

sections.description:
DIGISTALTER Immobilienverwaltung turns WordPress into a property management and presentation system for real estate agents and property companies. Properties are entered in a dedicated form and shown on a single property page and a filterable overview page that automatically take on the design of your active theme. Inquiries land in a built-in CRM, and every property for sale comes with a financing calculator.

The plugin is free, with no limit on the number of properties and no features locked behind a paid tier.

Property management

  • A dedicated entry form: core data, property details, description, media, energy certificate and agent commission.
  • Property type (residential, commercial, land – each with subcategories), marketing type (buy, rent) and availability (available, reserved, sold, rented) as protected classifications.
  • Only the fields that fit the selected property and marketing type are shown – and those are required, so no listing goes online incomplete.
  • Numbers are entered with thousands separators and units (€, m², %).
  • Media gallery with drag-and-drop order, featured image and captions. The order you set is exactly the order on the property page.
  • Every property gets a permanent property number, which is also used in its URL.
  • Assign a WordPress user as contact person for each property. They appear with their profile picture on the property page and receive the inquiries for it.

Customer inquiries (CRM)

  • Inquiries from the property page (first name, last name, phone, email, message) land in the inquiry management screen with status, notes and history.
  • Email notification to the property’s contact person – or, if none is set, to the site’s admin address.
  • Spam protection without a CAPTCHA: honeypot, time trap and rate limiting.
  • Consent is recorded with every inquiry; IP addresses are stored only in truncated form.
  • Contacts can be exported and erased completely with WordPress’ own personal data tools.

Financing calculator

Every property for sale shows a financing calculator: purchase price, incidental purchase costs (real estate transfer tax by federal state, agent commission, notary and land registry fees), adjustable equity and repayment rate, and a non-binding example instalment. A representative example (Section 6a PAngV) and a note that the calculation is for orientation only are shown below it.

The calculator’s terms – transfer tax rates, fees, interest rate and representative example – are maintained by us together with our financing partner and kept up to date through plugin updates. There is nothing to configure.

Prospects can ask to be put in touch with a financing advisor when sending an inquiry. See “External services” below for what is transmitted.

The financing calculator and the financing advisor option are aimed at buyers in Germany and are only shown when the site language is German (de_DE, informal or formal).

OpenImmo export

Under Settings, export your properties as an OpenImmo file – the standard format for German property portals and real estate software:

  • All published properties, or only the available ones.
  • As a ZIP file with all details and images for uploading to a portal, or as a single XML file with linked images.
  • Optional provider ID (ANID) and provider number from the portal are saved for the next export.
  • The file is valid against the official OpenImmo 1.2.7 schema.

Frontend

  • The single property page and the overview page with filters and search take on the header, footer, colors and fonts of the active theme.
  • The property page is always shown in full – including the financing calculator and the inquiry form – even if a page builder such as Elementor or Divi is active.
  • “Latest properties” block and pattern: the three newest properties as tiles, e.g. for the home page. Also available as the shortcode [digi_immo_latest_properties].
  • Price per square meter, energy efficiency scale, image grid for up to three images and a carousel from four images on.
  • Works with any block theme; classic themes are supported through a fallback.

Permissions

Administrators and editors can use and manage everything. The plugin does not add its own user role.

Translations

All texts are in English and can be translated on translate.wordpress.org. German is bundled (informal and formal), including Austrian and Swiss variants.

External services

This plugin connects to one external service, and only when a prospect actively asks for it.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via “Plugins → Add New” or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add your first property via “Immobilien → Neu hinzufügen” (Properties → Add new).
  4. Optionally assign a contact person to each property in its edit screen.
sections.faq:
Do I need to adapt my theme?

No. The property page and the overview page automatically take on the header, footer, colors and fonts of the active theme.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi or other page builders?

Yes. The property page is always rendered by the plugin, so the financing calculator and the inquiry form are always there.

Does the plugin add a credit link to my website?

Only if you want it to. A small “Powered by DIGISTALTER GmbH” link below the contact area can be switched on under Settings; it is off by default.

Is there a limit on how many properties I can manage?

No. All properties can be managed and published without limit.

Do I have to maintain the financing calculator’s rates?

No. Transfer tax rates, fees, interest rate and the representative example are maintained by us and updated with the plugin.

How do I get my properties into a property portal?

Under Settings → Export properties, choose “Upload to a property portal” and download the ZIP file. Upload it in the portal’s OpenImmo import. If the portal gave you a provider ID (ANID) or provider number, enter it under “Details for property portals”.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

By default, everything is kept. Only if “Permanently remove all data when the plugin is uninstalled” is switched on under Settings does uninstalling remove properties, inquiries, contacts and settings.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: OpenImmo export (ZIP with images or XML) under Settings, valid against the official OpenImmo 1.2.7 schema.
  • New: “Latest properties” block, pattern and shortcode.
  • New: consent to be contacted by a financing advisor names the partner with full address and is recorded as proof on the inquiry. Only name, email, phone and the property are transmitted.
  • New: profile picture for contact persons from the media library.
  • Financing calculator: clearer wording (“Financing orientation”, assumed borrowing and repayment rate, non-binding example instalment) and a note that the calculation is for orientation only. All terms are now maintained through plugin updates instead of settings.
  • Property page: always shown in full with page builders such as Elementor or Divi; image grid for up to three images, carousel from four; captions; details and energy certificate use the full content width.
  • Property editor: reorganised layout, drag-and-drop media order, captions, thousands separators and units in number fields.
  • Inquiry form with separate first and last name.
  • Settings: on/off switches, clearer layout, optional “Powered by” link on property pages (off by default).
  • Permissions: administrators and editors manage everything; the plugin’s own user role has been removed (its users become editors).
  • Removed: the standalone financing calculator block and the suggested privacy policy text.

1.1.0

  • Representative example (Section 6a PAngV) below every financing calculator, linked to the advertised instalment by a footnote.
  • Incidental purchase costs (real estate transfer tax, agent commission, notary and land registry fees) in the calculator.
  • The inquiry form links to your privacy policy page.

1.0.0

  • First release: property management with required-field validation, property and overview pages in the design of the active theme, customer inquiry CRM, financing calculator and contact persons.
  • English source texts, German translations bundled (informal and formal, including Austrian and Swiss variants).
